top_extraction_candidates.name: cursor-list pattern (members/invites)
top_extraction_candidates.why: this repo has the most deliberately-designed cursor-pagination contract of anything surveyed in L7 (opaque createdAt cursor, ORG_LIST_LIMIT=200, total repeated every page, born from a real defect in issue #14) but zero shared client-side pagination-control UI -- both OrgMembersPanel and OrgInvitesPanel hand-roll their own load-more logic against the identical shape

notes: This is a genuinely new create-narduk-app scaffold: only 21 .vue files, no login/register page files locally (narduk-auth supplies those via its Nuxt layer), and zero explicit narduk-core/narduk-auth component tag usage anywhere -- narduk-core and narduk-auth are consumed entirely through layout/module wiring, not template imports. No table pattern exists in this app at all (0 hits for <table>/<UTable>/role=table); the closest thing is three cursor-paginated list panels (members/invites/claims) that render as <li>/<dl> lists, not tables. narduk-mapkit(-nuxt) is notably NOT a dependency here despite PassageMap.vue doing map rendering -- worth the orchestrator checking what PassageMap actually wraps.
